name: tab01
definition: 主业务记录表 Counterexample: 与tab03易混淆：两者共享fld001列，但tab03字段数不同（22列），需按实际列集合与业务用途区分，不能仅凭共享列判定为同一实体 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab01; provenance: direct source tab01

name: tab02
definition: 辅助业务记录表 Counterexample: 与tab01/tab03无共享列，字段编码区间（fld030-fld040）独立，易被误判为同一表族成员，实际无列级证据支持 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab02; provenance: direct source tab02

name: tab03
definition: 明细业务记录表 Counterexample: 与tab01共享fld001，易被误判为tab01的子表或同族表；但共享列是否为外键、父键是否唯一均无证据，仅能作为候选关系 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab03; provenance: direct source tab03

name: School
definition: A school record in the school directory

name: EligibleFreeCount
definition: Number of students eligible for free or reduced price meals

name: EligibleFreeRate
definition: Share of enrolled students eligible for free or reduced price meals Formula: EligibleFreeCount / Enrollment. Inputs: EligibleFreeCount = tab01.fld020; Enrollment = tab01.fld019
aliases: free or reduced price meal rate

name: TotalEnrollment
definition: Sum of enrolled students Formula: SUM(Enrollment). Inputs: Enrollment = tab01.fld019

name: TotalEligibleFree
definition: Sum of students eligible for free or reduced price meals Formula: SUM(EligibleFreeCount). Inputs: EligibleFreeCount = tab01.fld020
aliases: total free or reduced price meals

name: SchoolCount
definition: Count of school records Formula: COUNT(School). Inputs: School = tab01.fld001

name: HighEnrollmentEligibleFreeRate
definition: Eligible free rate for schools ranked by enrollment Formula: EligibleFreeCount / Enrollment ORDER BY Enrollment DESC. Inputs: EligibleFreeCount = tab01.fld020; Enrollment = tab01.fld019
aliases: eligible free rate of highest enrolment schools
